summary: Sin (plan 5.5 and 13.10, G4; ours, built from the book's pieces; story/sin.gd): a hidden tally of the party's wickedness. Each source counts `per` points: the Crooked Bargains (dark gifts) the party carries, and int flags the story adds to with `set <flag> += 1`. The tally's tier sets how hard the Horned King's temptations press (`press`), how many Ritual Points Kehlenn has against the final sacrifice (`ritual_points`, added to the sacrifice's base), and which epilogue lines play (`tarokka.sin.tier == wicked`, `tarokka.sin.at_least.stained`). The numbers are ours; check them against the finale digest when the sacrifice is balanced.

sources.summary: Each Crooked Bargain (a dark gift) a hero carries, in the party or out of it.
Each deal or ware taken from Mister Crossroads's shack.
Each of the Horned King's bargains a hero took (R24's offers in the Wytchwood and at death's door).
Each innocent the party killed or let die by its own hand.
Each of the village's Connections the party betrayed.
Any other wickedness a scene marks.
